newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Vernon confirmed winner of Maungakiekie seat.
newsitem.headline: Vernon confirmed winner of Maungakiekie seat.

text.p: National Party's Belinda Vernon was confirmed as the winner of the Maungakiekie seat, the New Zealand Press Association reported on Thursday.
On election night, Vernon led Labour's Richard Northey by 9,949 votes to 9,760.
Vernon increased her majority over Labour sitting MP Richard Northey to 226, from 189 on election night.

Earlier, Labour MP Whetu Tirikatene-Sullivan conceded defeat to New Zealand First's Tutekawa Wyllie in the Te Tai Tonga Maori electorate after counting of special votes, confirming NZ First's clean sweep of all five Maori electorates in the October 12 general election.
The results mean no electorates have changed hands after special votes have been counted.
